summary: Re-verified image generation stack after model fix (gemini-2.5-flash-image-preview -> gemini-2.5-flash-image). Backend: TestImage class now 2/2 PASS — /api/generate-image returns HTTP 200 with valid base64 PNG (>100 bytes decoded), /api/edit-image returns HTTP 200 with base64 image. Frontend: ImageGen (/image-gen) end-to-end works — prompt -> click image-gen-run -> image-gen-result rendered within ~10s -> /projects shows a new 'Gambar AI' card with the correct thumbnail. PhotoEdit (/photo) end-to-end works — upload tiny PNG via hidden photo-source-input, type photo-prompt, click photo-generate, photo-result appears -> /projects shows a new 'Edit Foto' card with sunset-colored thumbnail. All prior passing tests remain green.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py generate_image and edit_image still duplicate LlmChat construction; extract a helper to DRY.
Project.payload/thumbnail_base64 have no size cap — video_base64 persistence could hit MongoDB 16MB doc limit.
seed_data_creation: Created two projects during frontend E2E (one photo_edit, one image_gen); both deleted post-test via DELETE /api/projects/{id}. No residual test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Image gen/edit fully working. Model id 'gemini-2.5-flash-image' is the correct Nano Banana slug for the Emergent LLM proxy. Video (Sora 2) endpoint only tested for kickoff+status previously — full completion was not verified end-to-end because it can take up to 9min.
rca_of_the_issue: Previous 500 was caused by using the unsupported model slug 'gemini-2.5-flash-image-preview'. Switching to 'gemini-2.5-flash-image' resolved it — confirmed via pytest and by real UI flow producing a sunset-colored edit of a 1x1 PNG and a red apple text-to-image.
